item.title: Faridabad school teacher stabbed to death by masked man; CCTV captures attack
item.summary: In a tragic incident at a local school, a 26-year-old teacher was brutally stabbed by a masked assailant. Reports indicate that the attacker waited near the classroom before launching a sudden assault with a knife. Surveillance footage documented the horrifying event, leading to the victim's death. Authorities are actively investigating this shocking crime and are on the hunt for the unidentified attacker.
